body:
Role-local Mirror receipt for Authority issue Goldkelch/qik-vrt#753.

Preserve the Product Owner input and audio-origin binding without inventing Authority execution or whole-tree convergence.

Mirror handling must preserve the same claim/evidence boundaries and venue separation: peer-reviewed journals, Zenodo, arXiv, IETF, Wikipedia, and GitHub software artifacts remain distinct publication/evidence channels.

No PASS, FINAL_PASS, EFFECT_ACK_DONE, peer-review, DOI, arXiv acceptance, IETF consensus, Wikipedia acceptance, Planck-scale measurement, black-hole-interior observation, or causal-past signalling claim may be inherited from Authority without explicit evidence.
title: Mirror receipt: Authority #753 predictive-optimality publication routing
